# Copilot instructions — dihiggs_hep_cross

See `AGENTS.md` at the repository root for the full data-authority pointer —
it applies to GitHub Copilot equally. In short: **before citing any numerical
DiHiggs result, read `docs/CURRENT_DATA_AUTHORITY.md` and
`state/CURRENT_CAMPAIGN.yaml` first.** There are currently no authoritative
MadGraph results (`state/CURRENT_CAMPAIGN.yaml`'s
`madgraph.authoritative_results` is `null`).

A MadGraph cross section is incomplete metadata unless it includes: mH2,
GHphiphi, coupling prescription, process, sqrt(s), UFO identity, seed, and a
banner/source artifact.
